newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land sees profits dipping in future years.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land sees profits dipping in future years.

text.p: The president of Tokyo Disneyland operator Oriental Land Co Ltd said on Wednesday that the company expects its profits to dip in the 1998/99 and 2001/2002 business years.

Toshio Kagami told a news conference the reason for the expected decline in profits was investment in a second theme park. After the park opens in 2001, the depreciation of facilities was also expected to reduce profits, he said.
Oriental Land currently operates the Tokyo Disneyland theme park, which is located just outside of Tokyo.
The company's shares were listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
